checks: Two map taps opened the exact Core review; the third explicit tap saved the rider request.
Initial rider has no horizontal overflow at 320 and 390px display widths.
Accepting the preferred rider request shows pickup #1 and dropoff #2; admin assignment rate changes from 0.0% to 50.0% (1/2 vehicles).
Boarding changes the next stop and Google Maps destination to dropoff; admin occupancy becomes 16.7% (1/6 seats).
Completion increases completed rides from 6 to 7 and people transported from 7 to 8; assignment and occupancy both return to 0.0%.
Today/7-day/30-day controls and configured 09:00–17:00 elapsed operating windows render analysis with explicit denominators.
Reloading restores the last completed trip shortcut; one tap opens the exact Core review and Back creates no new ride.
scope: Public Chromium UI using fictional browser-local records. Rider measured at 320×667 and 390×844; driver/admin visually checked at 320px; admin desktop width measured at 1348px. Native iOS/Android, Safari, GPS and live turn-by-turn navigation are not tested.
